Hi Helen — thanks for the heads up and for sharing procurement's list. Really glad the clinical evaluation landed well.

I’ve sketched a rapid rebaseline and an updated MAP that splits procurement gating into two clear checkpoints:
- Security evidence finalization (SOC addendum + audit log samples) — target by 7/10
- Contract & retention addendum sign-off — target by 7/17

Proposed commercial close date: 7/21 (was 6/30). I’ve attached a working MAP spreadsheet and a short procurement issue log for your steering meeting.

Can you confirm whether procurement needs a vendor-attested SOC addendum or whether the SOC 2 Type II report with supplemental notes will suffice? That influences the evidence delivery timeline.

Next steps for Redwood on our side:
- Karthik to lead evidence pack and run a one-hour SOC Q&A with Acme procurement (week of 6/30)
- Marcus to prepare a temporary credit proposal if there is a hard close extension requirement
- I’ll update the MAP and circulate a clean version by EOD Thursday.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Procurement_issue_log.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks —

Hey all — looping in technical/controls context. Quick notes after an initial review:

- SOC evidence: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and an audit log extract for a two-week scoped review. If procurement insists on a vendor-attested addendum, we can produce the addendum but legal will need a short review cycle (3 business days) and an in-line control mapping doc.
- Data retention addendum: our legal team has a standard addendum template; limited negotiation expected but expect a redline pass and sign-off within 5–7 business days.

Impact on timeline: if procurement accepts the SOC + log extract route, the security checkpoint can complete by 7/8. If the attested addendum route is required, push is to 7/15 for that gate.

I’m proposing a conservative MAP cadence: two weekly check-ins (Tue/Thu) until security is closed, then move to weekly. I’ve attached a short evidence checklist and a proposed Q&A slot calendar.

Attachments referenced: Evidence_checklist.docx (docx stub), Proposed_QA_slots.ics (calendar stub)

On the credit/escalation ask — happy to join any procurement call to accelerate evidence acceptance.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Acme Health MAP rebaseline & temporary commercial concession request — action needed

Marcus / Grace — request your help. Procurement at Acme has signaled that the SOC attestation addendum is their preferred route (they cited internal audit). That pushes our conservative close to 7/15–7/17.

Summary (short):
- Original close: 6/30 (missed)
- Recommended rebaseline commercial close: 7/21 (accounts for contract sign-off and a short post-sign checkpoint)
- Key blocker: procurement requires vendor-attested SOC addendum (legal + controls review time)
- Risk: if we cannot align acceptance criteria by 7/10, there is material risk to the 7/21 target and the account may request competitive hold options.

Requested decisions:
1) Approve a temporary commercial concession (one month credit on committed Dedicated capacity) to maintain momentum while procurement completes their attestation requirement.
2) Approve expedited legal review for the addendum (we estimate 3 business days if prioritized).

Action items I will drive:
- Finalize MAP (clean copy) and share with Acme by tomorrow EOD.
- Book Karthik for an evidence walkthrough with procurement (proposed Wed 7/2 11:00am PT).
- Stand up an internal war-room Slack channel for rapid signoffs.

Attached: clean_MAP_v2.xlsx (will be uploaded after internal review)
DocuSign reference: https://app.docusign.com/some-docusign-link/ACME-3784

Please advise if you need more color; Helen, thanks for staying flexible — we’ll aim to minimize calendar churn.

Best,
Kimberly Park
